# The Marsh by the Sea

## What Is a Marsh?

A marsh is a wet, muddy place near the sea. The ground is soft and squishy. Tall
green grass grows there. The sea comes in and goes out two times every day.

## Who Lives There?

Lots of animals live in the marsh!

- Little fish hide in the grass.
- Crabs dig holes in the mud.
- Birds come to find food.

The baby fish are safe in the grass. Big fish cannot reach them there.

## Why the Marsh Is Helpful

The marsh is like a big sponge. When a storm comes, the marsh soaks up the water.
This keeps the houses near the sea safe and dry.

The grass also cleans the water. The mud sinks down to the bottom. Then the water
is clear again.

## A Big Job

People are helping the marsh grow back. They plant new grass. They let the sea
come in again. Slowly, the animals come home.

The marsh is small, but it does a very big job!
